title: MyHouse.WAD - Inside Doom's Most Terrifying Mod
summary: A long video essay on MyHouse.wad, a Doom II mod uploaded by an anonymous user that hides unsettling secrets in its walls. It tells the story of the map, its mystery and its liminal horror.
why: Strongly recommended as a gripping story and art piece worth watching even if you do not care about games.

quote.text: Just click the link and watch. One of my favorite YouTube rides of all time.
